title: Seetha recollects the time limit
introduction: Seetha recollects the time limit of two months given by Ravana and her vulnerability of being killed by him. After lamenting for a while, she tries to strangle herself to death with the braid of her hair. At that moment, a propitious omen never seen before appears on her person.
closing: इत्यार्ष्ते श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टाविंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 28th Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic

verses.devanagari:
सा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वचो निशम्य |
तद्रावणस्याप्रियमप्रियार्ता |
सीता वितत्रास यथा वनान्ते |
सिंहाभिपन्ना गजराजकन्या
verses.iast:
sā rākṣasendrasya vaco niśamya |
tadrāvaṇasyāpriyamapriyārtā |
sītā vitatrāsa yathā vanānte |
siṃhābhipannā gajarājakanyā
verses.translation: That Seetha, hearing those unpleasant words of Ravana, tormented by grief, was frightened like a tiny female-elephant overpowered by a lion in the middle of a forest.

glosses.meaning: in the middle of a forest.

verses.devanagari:
सा राक्षसीमध्यगता च भीरु |
र्वाग्भिर्भृशं रावणतर्जिता च |
कान्तारमध्ये विजने विसृष्टा |
बालेव कन्या विललाप सीता
verses.iast:
sā rākṣasīmadhyagatā ca bhīru |
rvāgbhirbhṛśaṃ rāvaṇatarjitā ca |
kāntāramadhye vijane visṛṣṭā |
bāleva kanyā vilalāpa sītā
verses.translation: That fearful Seetha, who was situated in the middle of female-demons and also threatened by Ravana with his words galore, lamented (as follows) like a young virgin who was left lonely in the midst of a forest.

glosses.meaning: who was situated in the middle of female-demons
in the midst of a forest.

verses.devanagari:
सत्यं बतेदं प्रवदन्ति लोके |
नाकालमृत्युर्भवतीति सन्तः |
यत्राहमेवं परिभर्त्स्यमाना |
जीवामि दीना क्षणमप्यपुण्या
verses.iast:
satyaṃ batedaṃ pravadanti loke |
nākālamṛtyurbhavatīti santaḥ |
yatrāhamevaṃ paribhartsyamānā |
jīvāmi dīnā kṣaṇamapyapuṇyā
verses.translation: "Truly the saints affirm that untimely death does not come in the world, as I being impure am surviving even for an instant, though being threatened in this way."

verses.devanagari:
सुखाद्विहीनं बहुदुःखपूर्ण |
मिदं तु नूनं हृदयं स्थिरं मे |
विशीर्यते यन्न सहस्रधाद्य |
वज्राहतं शृङ्गमिवाचलस्य
verses.iast:
sukhādvihīnaṃ bahuduḥkhapūrṇa |
midaṃ tu nūnaṃ hṛdayaṃ sthiraṃ me |
viśīryate yanna sahasradhādya |
vajrāhataṃ śṛṇ^gamivācalasya
verses.translation: "Though devoid of happiness and frequently full of sorrow, my heart must be hard indeed, in that it does not break into a thousand pieces today like a mountain-top struck by lightning."

verses.devanagari:
वैवास्ति दोषो मम नूनमत्र |
वध्याहमस्याप्रियदर्शनस्य |
भावं न चास्याहमनुप्रदातु |
मलं द्विजो मन्त्रमिवाद्विजाय
verses.iast:
vaivāsti doṣo mama nūnamatra |
vadhyāhamasyāpriyadarśanasya |
bhāvaṃ na cāsyāhamanupradātu |
malaṃ dvijo mantramivādvijāya
verses.translation: "There is no fault of mine in this matter. I have become killable at the hands of this demon of disagreeable perception. I am not able to give him my affection any more than a member of the twice-born classes would offer a mystical verse to one not belonging to the twice-born classes."

glosses.meaning: to one not belonging to the twice-born classes
by a member of the twice-born class.

verses.devanagari:
नूनं ममाङ्गान्यचिरादनार्यः |
शस्त्रैः शितै श्छेत्स्यति राक्षसेन्द्रः |
तस्मिन्ननागच्छति लोकनाथे |
गर्भस्थजन्तोरिव शल्यकृन्तः
verses.iast:
nūnaṃ mamāṇ^gānyacirādanāryaḥ |
śastraiḥ śitai śchetsyati rākṣasendraḥ |
tasminnanāgacchati lokanāthe |
garbhasthajantoriva śalyakṛntaḥ
verses.translation: "If Rama the Ruler of the world does not come here, the evil Ravana, the king of Demons will cut off my limbs with his sharpened weapons, even as a surgeon would cut the limbs of a lifeless feotus."

glosses.meaning: a (lifeless) feotus situated in the womb.

verses.devanagari:
दुःखं बतेदं मम दुःखिताया |
मासौ चिरायाधिगमिष्यतो द्वौ |
बद्धस्य वध्यस्य तथा निशान्ते |
राजापराधादिव तस्करस्य
verses.iast:
duḥkhaṃ batedaṃ mama duḥkhitāyā |
māsau cirāyādhigamiṣyato dvau |
baddhasya vadhyasya tathā niśānte |
rājāparādhādiva taskarasya
verses.translation: "To me lamenting, two months will go up to a long time, as at the end of a night a thief imprisoned and to be capitally punished under the detention orders of a king. Alas! This is painful."

glosses.meaning: as at the end of a night
under the detention orders of a king

verses.devanagari:
हा राम हा लक्ष्मण हा सुमित्रे |
हा राममातः सह मे जनन्या |
एषा विपद्याम्यहमल्पभाग्या |
महार्णवे नौरिव मूढवाता
verses.iast:
hā rāma hā lakṣmaṇa hā sumitre |
hā rāmamātaḥ saha me jananyā |
eṣā vipadyāmyahamalpabhāgyā |
mahārṇave nauriva mūḍhavātā
verses.translation: "O Rama, O Lakshmana, O Sumitra, O Kausalya! O mother! I, of a scanty fortune, am going to be destroyed, like a ship driven out of its course by a strong wind in a mighty ocean."

glosses.meaning: driven out of its course by a strong wind

verses.devanagari:
तरस्विनौ धारयता मृगस्य |
सत्त्वेन रूपं मनुजेन्द्रपुत्रौ |
नूनं विशस्तौ मम कारणात्तौ |
सिंहर्षभौ द्वाविव वैद्युतेन
verses.iast:
tarasvinau dhārayatā mṛgasya |
sattvena rūpaṃ manujendraputrau |
nūnaṃ viśastau mama kāraṇāttau |
siṃharṣabhau dvāviva vaidyutena
verses.translation: "In the disguise of a deer, those two energetic sons of Dasaratha were surely killed for my sake, as two excellent lions killed by a flashing thunderbolt."

verses.devanagari:
नूनं स कालो मृगरूपधारी |
मामल्पभाग्यां लुलुभे तदानीम् |
यत्रार्यपुत्रं विससर्ज मूढा |
रामानुजं लक्ष्मणपूर्वजं च
verses.iast:
nūnaṃ sa kālo mṛgarūpadhārī |
māmalpabhāgyāṃ lulubhe tadānīm |
yatrāryaputraṃ visasarja mūḍhā |
rāmānujaṃ lakṣmaṇapūrvajaṃ ca
verses.translation: "Certainly that Time-spirit, assuming the guise of a deer, allured me, a woman of poor fortune at that time and to whom I, a stupid woman, sent forth (far away) Lakshmana and the noble prince Rama the elder brother of Lakshmana."

glosses.meaning: assuming the guise of a deer
Rama the elder brother of Lakshmana.

verses.devanagari:
हा राम सत्यव्रत दीर्घबाहो |
हा पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतिमानवक्त्र |
हा जीवलोकस्य हितः प्रियश्च |
वध्यां न मां वेत्सि हि राक्षसानाम्
verses.iast:
hā rāma satyavrata dīrghabāho |
hā pūrṇacandrapratimānavaktra |
hā jīvalokasya hitaḥ priyaśca |
vadhyāṃ na māṃ vetsi hi rākṣasānām
verses.translation: "O Rama, the strictly truthful man and the long-armed, O the man whose face resembles the full-moon! You, who are well-disposed of the world of living beings, do not indeed know me to have been sentenced to death by the demons."

glosses.meaning: O the man whose face resembles the full-moon
of the world of living beings! Na vetsi hi = do not indeed know
to have been sentenced to dealth

verses.devanagari:
अनन्यदैवत्वमियं क्षमा च |
भूमौ च शय्या नियमश्च धर्मे |
पतिव्रतात्वं विफलं ममेदम् |
कृतं कृतघ्नेष्विव मानुषाणाम्
verses.iast:
ananyadaivatvamiyaṃ kṣamā ca |
bhūmau ca śayyā niyamaśca dharme |
pativratātvaṃ viphalaṃ mamedam |
kṛtaṃ kṛtaghneṣviva mānuṣāṇām
verses.translation: "My not having a deity (other than my husband), this patience, my reposing on the floor, my restriction in righteousness, my devotion to the husband - all this has become a waste, like a good act done by men to ungrateful men becoming waste".

glosses.meaning: (My) not having a deity (other than my husband)
like a good act done by men

verses.devanagari:
मोघो हि धर्मश्चरितो मयायं |
तथैकपत्नीत्वमिदं निरर्थम् |
या त्वां न पश्यामि कृशा विवर्णा |
हीना त्वया संगमने निराशा
verses.iast:
mogho hi dharmaścarito mayāyaṃ |
tathaikapatnītvamidaṃ nirartham |
yā tvāṃ na paśyāmi kṛśā vivarṇā |
hīnā tvayā saṅgamane nirāśā
verses.translation: "For me who is not seeing you, who is bereft of you, who is not hopeful of coming into contact with you, who is emaciated and pale in complexion this righteous act performed by me has indeed become a waste. Likewise, this state of my being only one wife to you has become useless.."

glosses.meaning: of coming into contact with you

verses.devanagari:
पितुर्निदेशं नियमेन कृत्वा वनान्निवृत्तश्चरितव्रतश्च |
स्त्रीभिस्तु मन्ये विपुलेक्षणाभिस्त्वं रंस्यसे वीतभयः कृतार्थः
verses.iast:
piturnideśaṃ niyamena kṛtvā vanānnivṛttaścaritavrataśca |
strībhistu manye vipulekṣaṇābhistvaṃ raṃsyase vītabhayaḥ kṛtārthaḥ
verses.translation: "Having fulfilled your father's command as per the order of his words and observed your vow, you return from the forest fearlessly and having accomplished your purpose, I think you will enjoy carnally with large-eyed women."

glosses.meaning: as per the order of his words

verses.devanagari:
अहं तु राम त्वयि जातकामा चिरं विनाशाय निबद्धभावा |
मोघं चरित्वाथ तपो व्रतञ्च त्यक्ष्यामि धिग्जीवितमल्पभाग्याम्
verses.iast:
ahaṃ tu rāma tvayi jātakāmā ciraṃ vināśāya nibaddhabhāvā |
moghaṃ caritvātha tapo vrataJṇca tyakṣyāmi dhigjīvitamalpabhāgyām
verses.translation: "O Rama! Having performed austerity and vow in vain, I for myself who has fallen in love with you and in whose was confined an affection for you for a long time, for my own destruction, I can lose my life. Woe to me of my little fortune!"

glosses.meaning: in whose was confined an affection for you
and who has fallen in love

verses.devanagari:
सा जीवितं क्षिप्रमहं त्यजेयं |
विषेण शस्त्रेण शितेन वापि |
विषस्य दाता न हि मेऽस्ति कश्चि |
च्छस्त्रस्य वा वेश्मनि राक्षसस्य
verses.iast:
sā jīvitaṃ kṣipramahaṃ tyajeyaṃ |
viṣeṇa śastreṇa śitena vāpi |
viṣasya dātā na hi me'sti kaści |
cchastrasya vā veśmani rākṣasasya
verses.translation: "I as such will abandon quickly my life by poison or by a sharp weapon. To me, none is there, who is a giver either of a poison or of a sharp weapon in the house of Ravana."

verses.devanagari:
इतीव देवी बहुधा विलप्य |
सर्वात्मना राममनुस्मरन्ती |
प्रवेपमाना परिशुष्कवक्त्रा |
नगोत्तमं पुष्पितमाससाद
verses.iast:
itīva devī bahudhā vilapya |
sarvātmanā rāmamanusmarantī |
pravepamānā pariśuṣkavaktrā |
nagottamaṃ puṣpitamāsasāda
verses.translation: Thus lamenting in several ways, Seetha was recollecting Rama in all spirits and trembling with and emaciated face, approached that excellent tree in bloom.

verses.devanagari:
सा शोकतप्ता बहुधा विचिन्त्य |
सीताथ वेण्युद्ग्रथनं गृहीत्वा |
उद्भुध्य वेण्युद्ग्रथनेन श्रीघ्र |
महं गमिष्यामि यमस्य मूलम्
verses.iast:
sā śokataptā bahudhā vicintya |
sītātha veṇyudgrathanaṃ gṛhītvā |
udbhudhya veṇyudgrathanena śrīghra |
mahaṃ gamiṣyāmi yamasya mūlam
verses.translation: Seetha, who was tormented with grief, thus thinking in various ways and thereafter holding her braid of hair looking like a hanging rope (now thought within herself) "I shall go to the presence of Yama the God of Death by tying my neck quickly with my braid of hair looking like a hanging rope"

glosses.meaning: her braid of hair looking like a hanging rope
to the presence of Yama the God of Death
with my braid of hair looking

verses.devanagari:
उपस्थिता सा मृदुसर्वगात्री |
शाखां गृहीत्वाथ नगस्य तस्य |
तस्यास्तु रामं प्रविचिन्तयन्त्या |
रामानुजं स्वं च कुलं शुभाङ्ग्याः
शोकानिमित्तानि तथा बहूनि |
धैर्यार्जितानि प्रवराणि लोके |
प्रादुर्निमित्तानि तदा बभूवुः |
पुरापि सिद्धान्युपलक्षितानि
verses.iast:
upasthitā sā mṛdusarvagātrī |
śākhāṃ gṛhītvātha nagasya tasya |
tasyāstu rāmaṃ pravicintayantyā |
rāmānujaṃ svaṃ ca kulaṃ śubhāṇ^gyāḥ
śokānimittāni tathā bahūni |
dhairyārjitāni pravarāṇi loke |
prādurnimittāni tadā babhūvuḥ |
purāpi siddhānyupalakṣitāni
verses.translation: Thereafter Seetha with all her soft limbs stood seizing a branch of that tree. To her having handsome limbs, who was thinking of Rama, Lakshmana and her own race, then appeared many omens, which were not having adequate occasion for grief, which procured courage in the world, which were excellent and which were seen earlier also as thoroughly efficacious.

glosses.meaning: not having adequate occasion for grief
